entities.summary: Joshua Thomas Doan is an American professional ice hockey player who is a right winger for the Buffalo Sabres of the National Hockey League (NHL). The Arizona Coyotes selected Doan with the 37th overall pick in the 2021 NHL entry draft. He is the son of Coyotes franchise scoring leader Shane Doan.
